lines: “Based on this performance and our outlook for the remainder of the year, we are once again raising our 2026 financial guidance, reflecting the momentum we continue to see across the business.” Exhibit 99.1
ONEOK increased 2026 net income guidance to a range of $4.09 billion to $4.27 billion.
Total 2026 capital expenditure guidance is expected to be approximately $3.5 billion.

ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Oct. 27, 2026 Page 3 -more- Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Performance: ONEOK reported third-quarter 2026 net income attributable to ONEOK of $1.35 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $2.24 billion.

ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Oct. 27, 2026 Page 5 -more- ◦ $10 million decrease from higher employee-related costs associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations. ◦ $7 million increase from lower property taxes due primarily to timing.
